description: Enumerate the vault's saved spaces (from TaskForge/Settings/spaces.json) as the friendly SpaceSummary view — id, name, display_name, hidden, is_builtin, display_order, target_kind. This is the structured equivalent of the CLI `spaces` verb (distinct from the raw taskforge://spaces resource, which returns the on-disk JSON document). Set all:true to include hidden spaces (default excludes them); set counts:true to run a full vault scan and return a membership `count` per space (null with a warning for a space whose filter can't be faithfully evaluated — never a wrong count). Read-only.

all.description:
Include `hidden` spaces too. Default false — hidden spaces are
omitted, mirroring the CLI `spaces` default.

counts.description:
Run a full vault scan and evaluate each visible space's filter,
returning a `count` per space (`null` for a space whose filter can't
be faithfully evaluated, with a warning — never a wrong count).
Default false (no counts, no scan).

name: list_spaces
